scripts.translation: 你試著取出記憶音盤，連線處卻咔嚓一聲斷開，散成了原來的幾片。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Darn. There's only one content but it annoyingly breaks every time it doesn't play.
I'm starting to think it's made like this on purpose.
Annoying to clean up..
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
該死，內容只有一段，可每次沒播完就會壞掉，真煩人。
我開始懷疑這是有人故意設計的。
收拾起來也麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Why make things like this with all that science and talent and whatnot?
Not to mention there is the occasional overlap..
It feels like someone is coaxing us to find out about the past no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
費了那麼多心思和技術，為什麼要把東西做成這樣？
而且內容偶爾還會重疊...
感覺像是有人在引導我們，無論如何都要去了解過去。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Anyway I will record this content separately and deliver it to the old man.
Good work today.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
總之，我會把這段內容單獨記錄下來，交給那個老人。
今天辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Then come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Wait, something is going on?
That tent there is where the excavation team is, right?
It seems someone is visiting?
Go along now!
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
等等，發生什麼事了？
那邊的帳篷是挖掘隊駐紮的地方吧？
好像有人來訪？
快過去看看！

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: Your whole body suddenly becomes heavy and time seems to be passing faster around you.
scripts.translation: 你的身體突然變得沉重，周圍的時間似乎也加快了。

scripts.text: Your whole body suddenly becomes heavy and time seems to be passing faster around you.
scripts.translation: 你的身體突然變得沉重，周圍的時間似乎也加快了。

scripts.text: Ah- This cozy and snug fe...el.....ling
scripts.translation: 啊...這舒適愜意的感...覺...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
First congratulations on surviving. I'm glad you got into the air-raid shelter. If you were outside..
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
首先，恭喜你活了下來。幸好你躲進了防空洞。要是當時在外面...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
...
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Whew.. even thinking about it makes me dizzy. Both of us were lucky. Don't you think so?
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
呼...光是想想就頭暈。我們倆都算走運，你說呢？

scripts.text: I think so too.
scripts.translation: 我也這麼覺得。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I feel a lot of sympathy though. It looks like a lot of people are blaming this explosion on Fresa.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
不過我挺同情她的。大家似乎都把這次爆炸怪到弗雷薩頭上。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
The explosion can't be only Lona's responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
這次爆炸不能只怪洛娜一個人。

scripts.text: Lona?
scripts.translation: 洛娜？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
A great person for sure despite failing the experiment.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
雖然實驗失敗了，但她確實是個了不起的人。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
She took charge of figuring out the number of survivors in that confusing mess of a situation.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
當時情況那麼混亂，她還是主動去統計倖存者人數。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
If it was me...
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
要是換作我...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I would probably be wandering around without knowing what do to right about now..
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
我現在大概還在不知所措地四處亂轉...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ugh- I guess even I should go and help. Want to help?
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
唉...我想我也該去幫忙了。你也想一起去嗎？

scripts.text: Agree to help.
scripts.translation: 答應幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Really? You will help? What a relief because I wasn't confident about going by myself.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
真的嗎？你願意幫忙？太好了，我本來還擔心自己一個人應付不來。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
There is a researcher with a cold demeanor in the center of this room, right?
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
這個房間中央有位神情冷淡的研究員，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
She is the head of the experiment, Lona Fresa. People usually call her Dr. Fresa.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
她就是實驗負責人洛娜·弗雷薩。大家都叫她弗雷薩博士。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Do you want to go and ask her if she needs any help?
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
你願意去問問她需不需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
There is a researcher with a cold demeanor in the center of this room, right?
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
這個房間中央有位神情冷淡的研究員，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Do you want to go and ask her if she needs any help?
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
你願意去問問她需不需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I was asked to find out how many are capable of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
他們讓我調查有多少人會做飯。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
We have to try hard even though the air-raid shelter is complex and wide.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
防空洞又大又複雜，但我們還是得盡力找人。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Thanks for helping her.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
謝謝你幫她。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Is it because we helped? I thought I saw a faint smile on her face.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
是因為我們幫忙了嗎？我好像看到她臉上閃過一絲微笑。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Uh?! I don't think I've seen you before in the air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
咦？我好像沒在防空洞裡見過你？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ah! Are you the Adventurer who's helping with moving the newly made air cleaning unit?
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
啊！你就是那個幫忙搬運新制空氣淨化裝置的冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
You are working a lot because of those thoughtless Mechanicians.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
那些不負責任的機械師害你忙壞了。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
The Bioengineers succeeded in cultivating grapes right?
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
聽說生物工程師成功培育出葡萄了？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
They say at least one grape harvest every 2 weeks is possible? The harvest day is probably either today or tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
聽說至少每兩週就能收穫一次。收穫日應該就在今天或明天吧？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I want to taste fresh grapes soon. I've been eating only dry food for the past few days.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
真想早點嚐嚐新鮮葡萄。這幾天我一直在吃乾糧。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
There's a rumor going around in the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
防空洞裡最近有個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
A while ago the Chemical Substance Specialist and a few others went outside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
不久前，化學物質專家等幾個人離開過防空洞。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Apparently some contaminated substance got inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
據說有某種受汙染的物質進入了防空洞。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I heard the number of convulsing patients are rapidly increasing because of the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
聽說受到汙染物影響，抽搐的病人正在迅速增加。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ah! It's just a rumor! A Rumor!!
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
啊！這只是個傳聞！只是傳聞！！

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
It seems the rumor going around was true.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
看來那個傳聞是真的。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I hear they are moving supplies to the clean Zone Z-2 even though it's newly opened because of the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
聽說汙染物擴散後，他們正把物資轉移到新開放的潔淨區 Z-2。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I think I will lend a hand even just a little.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
我想我也能幫上一點忙。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Nice to meet you, my name is Bunker Sayhu.
scripts.translation:
[掩體賽胡]
幸會，我叫賽胡，是防空洞的居民。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I am sorry. Right now I am a little busy with several problems. Can we speak later?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
抱歉，我現在正忙著處理幾個問題。稍後再談好嗎？

scripts.text: No! What I mean..
scripts.translation: 不！我的意思是...

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
What?! The Adventurer wants to help me?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
什麼？！這位冒險者想幫我？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Good. The people are uncontrollable because they are shocked and confused.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
很好。大家受到驚嚇，又不知所措，已經亂成一團了。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
If the intimidating Adventurer helps out it will be easier to control the confused masses.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
要是有你這位可靠的冒險者幫忙，安撫這些慌亂的人就容易多了。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Good!! I approve. Just in time for a troublesome problem as well.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
很好！！我准許你幫忙。正好我這裡也有件棘手的事。

scripts.text: Troublesome problem?
scripts.translation: 棘手的事？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The personnel with various specialties such as yourself have not changed their positions and are easy to grasp, but the other employees are the problem.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
像您這樣有專長的人員一直待在原崗位，情況很容易掌握。麻煩的是其他員工。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Surely they are moving according to the Emergency Situation Guidelines of their respective teams.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
他們應該都按照各自團隊的緊急情況指南行動了。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I cannot figure out from here where they are and what they are doing.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
可我在這裡沒法確認他們各自去了哪裡、正在做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
So I was thinking if you
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
所以我在想，你能不能...

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you figure out the number of ^0000FFBioengineers ^000000?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能查出^0000FF生物工程師^000000的數量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you figure out the number of ^0000FFMechanicians^000000?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能查出^0000FF機械師^000000的數量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you figure out the number of ^0000FFFacilities managers^000000?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能查出^0000FF設施管理員^000000的數量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you figure out the number of ^0000FFChemical Substance Specialists^000000?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能查出^0000FF化學物質專家^000000的數量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I ask you for this favor even though it won't be easy in this large and complex shelter.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
儘管在這個龐大且複雜的避難所裡這並不容易，但我還是請求你幫這個忙。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Huh?! You're already back? You came back earlier than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
什麼？！你已經回來了？你比我預想的回來得早。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The favor that I asked.. ah?! Ah!!
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
我拜託你的事...啊？！啊！！

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFBioengineers^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF生物工程師^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFMechanicians^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF機械師^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFFacilities managers^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF設施管理員^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFChemical Substance Specialists^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF化學物質專家^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
{0} people you say?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你說有{0}人？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
That's strange? According to the list they have never been that number.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
奇怪，名單上的人數從來沒這麼多過。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you check again?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能再確認一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Ah! You are here. Isn't the interior of the shelter a bit complicated? The favor I asked of you..
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
啊！你來了。避難所裡面挺複雜的吧？我拜託你的事...

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFBioengineers^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF生物工程師^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:

The number of ^0000FFMechanicians^000000? How many do they say have survived?

[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF機械師^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFFacilities managers^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF設施管理員^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFChemical Substance Specialists^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF化學物質專家^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
{0} people you say?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你說有{0}人？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
That's strange? According to the list they have never been that number.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
這很奇怪？根據名單，人數從來沒有這麼多過。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you check again?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能再確認一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Really? It is roughly the same as the number on the list. Good work.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
真的嗎？大概和名單上的數字差不多。幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Sayhu says Adventurers like this kind of stuff. This is compensation for your help.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
賽胡說冒險者都喜歡這種東西。這是對你幫忙的報酬。

scripts.text: The small round capsule has percolated through the skin. It feels like experience has accumulated.
scripts.translation: 小小的圓形膠囊滲入了皮膚。感覺像是積累了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Good work. I know it is frustrating but I hope you will adjust to the life inside the air-raid shelter until the outside situation becomes safer.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
幹得好。我知道這讓人很不好受，但在外面的情況好轉、安全下來之前，希望你能適應避難所裡的生活。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]

scripts.translation:

幹得好。我知道這讓人很不好受，但在外面的情況好轉、安全下來之前，希望你能適應避難所裡的生活。

I am sorry. Right now I am a little busy with several problems. Can we speak later?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
抱歉。我現在正忙著處理幾個問題。我們稍後再對話好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
How did you come in? It's weird!
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你是怎麼進來的？真奇怪！

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I am sorry. Right now I am a little busy with several problems. Can we speak later?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
抱歉。我現在正忙著處理幾個問題。我們稍後再對話好嗎？

scripts.text: I have something urgent to tell you.
scripts.translation: 我有急事要告訴你

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
What?! What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
什麼？！發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: Explain current situation at the temporary clinic.
scripts.translation: 說明臨時診所的情況

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Patients are convulsing simultaneously.. this is not good.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
病人同時開始抽搐了...情況不妙。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I got it. We need to take measures.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
我明白了。我們需要採取措施。

scripts.text: The small round capsule has percolated through the skin. It feels like experience has accumulated.
scripts.translation: 小小的圓形膠囊滲入了皮膚。感覺像是積累了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Thank you for informing me.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
謝謝你通知我。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
This situation is grave so we need to quickly take measures.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
情況很嚴重，我們需要迅速採取措施。

scripts.text:

[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Are you an Adventurer? This is the machine warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你是冒險者嗎？這裡是機器倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
It was originally a warehouse but it is now being used by Mechanicians to assemble machines for the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
這裡原本是倉庫，但現在被機械師們用來組裝防空洞的機器。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
You want to know the total number of Mechanicians? I don't think I know?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你想知道機械師的總人數嗎？我想我不清楚？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Ah! Al up there might know. Go to Al.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
啊！阿爾應該知道。去找阿爾吧。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
An adventure to move the air cleaner?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
要去搬空氣清淨機嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
You look solid just like the other researchers mentioned. I bet you can lift the air cleaner like nothing!!
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你看起來很壯實，其他研究員也這麼說。我打賭你能輕輕鬆鬆把空氣清淨機抬起來！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We shouldn't be ordering people like you who got caught up in an accident, but the situation is urgent.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
我們不該讓像你這樣因事故受困的人幹活，但情況緊急，實在沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We made a new air cleaning unit because the one operating previously broke down a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
之前那臺空氣淨化裝置壞掉了，所以我們做了一臺新的。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We should have made it in modular form. Made it as one solid piece by mistake.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
早知道就該做成模組化的，結果一不小心做成了一個整體。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Didn't think of it when we were making it!!
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
製造的時候沒想到這一點！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
It happens. Right?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
這種事難免會發生，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Facilities managers are making a fuss about needing the air cleaning unit soon.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
設施管理員們一直催，說急著要空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We can't move the air cleaning unit with the equipment we have now..
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
光靠我們現在的裝置，沒法搬動這臺空氣淨化裝置...

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We could make the machine that can transport it if we had more time..
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
要是時間充裕，我們倒是能造一臺運輸它的機器...

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
So we ended up asking the strong Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
所以我們只好求助於強壯的冒險者。

scripts.text: Yes sir.
scripts.translation: 遵命，長官。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Aren't you refreshing!!
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你可真有幹勁！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We are counting on you. Take five air cleaning units to areas C-0, F-1, F-2, I-0, Z-0. Talk to me when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
就拜託你了。把5臺空氣淨化裝置分別送到C-0、F-1、F-2、I-0和Z-0區。準備好後告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Are you ready to move heavy objects?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你準備好搬運重物了嗎？

scripts.text: Give it to me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
You look strong but seems you are weak. You can't lift the air cleaning unit like that.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你看起來很強壯，可力氣似乎不夠。這樣可搬不動空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Deliver them to zones C-0, F-1, F-2, I-0, Z-0. The order doesn't matter and please be careful since they are precise machines.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
把裝置送到C-0、F-1、F-2、I-0和Z-0區，順序不限。它們是精密裝置，請小心搬運。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Good work. The air cleaning units are heavy, right?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
幹得好。這些空氣淨化裝置很重吧？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Sayhu says Adventurers like this kind of stuff and I should use this as compensation after giving you work.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
薩胡說冒險者喜歡這類東西，讓我把這個給你當報酬。

scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
你嘗過生物工程師培育的葡萄嗎？

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
Science is truly amazing to have us enjoy fresh grapes in this underground air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
科學真了不起，竟能讓我們在地下避難所裡也吃上新鮮葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
I think the air cleaner might be useless because the contaminant has already infiltrated the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
汙染物已經滲進避難所了，我覺得空氣清淨機可能也無濟於事。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
You are going through a lot.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
你也夠辛苦的。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
I don't know who equipped the air-raid shelter. But it surely is well made and sturdy.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
我不知道是誰建造了這個避難所，但這裡確實結實又牢靠。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We Bioengineers are doing all we can to produce food for the people inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我們生物工程師正竭盡全力，為避難所裡的人們生產食物。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We Bioengineers are doing all we can to produce food for the people inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我們生物工程師正竭盡全力，為避難所裡的人們生產食物。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Are you the Adventurer here to help us with the grape harvest? Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
你就是來幫忙收葡萄的冒險者嗎？很高興認識你。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Bioengineers alone do not have enough hands to harvest the amount of grapes we need to provide all the people inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
光靠生物工程師的人手，收穫的葡萄不夠供應避難所裡的所有人。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
So we ended up asking the Adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
所以我們只好請冒險者來幫忙。

scripts.text: Are there others who can help?
scripts.translation: 還有其他能幫忙的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Don't even mention it. We gave the task of harvesting grapes to the meandering Mechanicians and..
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
別提了。我們把收穫葡萄的任務交給了遊蕩的機械師，結果...

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
They ended up smashing one of the grape trees!!
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
他們竟然砸壞了一棵葡萄樹！！

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We were lucky to have found out and stopped them before they destroyed the other trees. The thought of it is horrible.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
幸好我們發現得早，在他們毀掉其他樹之前制止了他們。想想就讓人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Ah! That is not what's important.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
啊！這不是重點。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We used growth acceleration to make ripe grapes drop periodically.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我們使用了加速生長技術，讓成熟的葡萄定期掉落。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
It would be nice if you can wait in front of the grape tree and collect 30 bunches of grapes.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
你能在葡萄樹前等著，幫忙收集30串葡萄嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
You can collect more, but the remaining ones from the harvest will naturally decompose and disappear.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
你可以多收一些，不過這批收穫剩下的葡萄會自然腐爛、消失。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Then the soil fertility will recover partially. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
之後土壤肥力會部分恢復。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We have decided to give out one grape box per team.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我們決定每隊發一個葡萄箱。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
One box can hold 30~32 bunches so collect accordingly.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
一個箱子能裝30到32串葡萄，收集時請留意數量。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Whoa good job. As I thought Adventurers are so much more capable than Mechanicians.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
哇，幹得好！果然冒險者比機械師能幹多了。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Since the grapes are harvested should we deliver them to each team?
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
葡萄收好了，要不要把它們送給各個小組？

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
I will be rude and ask you another favor on top of your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
你已經很辛苦了，我還厚著臉皮想再拜託你一件事。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Let's see.. the grapes you just harvested
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我想想...你剛才收穫的葡萄

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
should be delivered to the Mechanical AI team. You can deliver this to Mugeosi.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
要送到機械師小組。把這箱葡萄交給穆格奧西就行。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
should be delivered to the Facilities manager team. You can deliver this to Remodeling.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
要送到設施管理員小組。把這箱葡萄交給改造就行。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
should be delivered to the Chemical Substance team. You can deliver this to Karsten.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
要送到化學物質小組。把這箱葡萄交給卡斯滕就行。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Oh! You do not have to come back after the deliveries. We will be busy starting the next project.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
哦！送完貨後您不必回來。我們要開始下一個專案了，會很忙。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
The people receiving the deliveries will probably give you compensation. If they don't, you can nag them.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
收貨的人大概會給你報酬。要是沒給，你就催催他們。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
That grape box you are holding
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
你手裡的那箱葡萄

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
has to be delivered to Mugeosi of the Mechanical AI team.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
要交給機械師小組的穆格奧西。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
has to be delivered to Remodeling of the Facilities manager team.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
要交給設施管理員小組的改造。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
has to be delivered to Karsten of the Chemical substance team.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
要交給化學物質小組的卡斯滕。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Compensation will be paid by the people receiving the deliveries so you do not have to come back here.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
報酬由接收貨物的人支付，所以您不必回到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
I thought I told you don't have to come back. Anyway how did you get inside?
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我不是說過不用回來嗎？算了，你是怎麼進來的？

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We Bioengineers are doing all we can to produce food for the people inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我們生物工程師正在竭盡全力，為防空洞內的人們生產食物。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Sorry. Did you wait long? There are a lot of suspected infection patients as you can see..
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
抱歉，讓你久等了吧？你也看到了，疑似感染的病人很多...

scripts.text: Not really..
scripts.translation: 沒有很久..

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Eh?! You didn't wait? That's strange? Did you cut in line? Cutting is bad.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
咦？！你沒等嗎？真奇怪。你插隊了？插隊可不好。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
As you know there are infectees who are suddenly showing strange phenomena..
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
你也知道，有些感染者會突然出現奇怪的症狀...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Um...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
...Ah...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
...啊...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
...Oh!!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
...哦！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I don't see any problematic symptoms. Fortunate.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
我沒發現什麼異常症狀。還好。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
We are having trouble because of the suddenly convulsing patients.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
那些突然抽搐的病人讓我們忙得不可開交。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Look here. My skin is getting crispy from not being able to sleep for days~
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
你看，我好幾天沒睡覺，皮膚都快乾裂了~

scripts.text: Thudunk!! Babang!! Crash!!
scripts.translation: 咚！砰！撞擊！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Yes.. Just like that
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
是的...就像那樣

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
... ...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
... ...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Argh!! Another convulsing patient.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
啊！！又有病人抽搐了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Hey. Aren't you an adventurer? You must be really strong.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
喂，你是冒險者吧？一定很強。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Can you suppress that convulsing patient? I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
能幫忙制伏那個抽搐的病人嗎？拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
You didn't get bit or scratched by the convulsing patient, did you?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
你沒被那個抽搐的病人咬傷或抓傷吧？

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Hmm~ I don't see any particular wounds.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
嗯~ 我沒看到什麼特別的傷口。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Since I can't figure out the infection route...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
既然還查不出感染途徑...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
We have to prepare for a possible disaster...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
我們就得為可能發生的災難做好準備...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Anyway, Adventurer~ Assuring and the best!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
總之，冒險者就是可靠又能幹！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I haven't been that bewildered by simultaneously convulsing patients before..
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
以前從未遇到過這麼多病人同時抽搐的情況...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Lucky you were here to suppress it with ease.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
幸好你在這裡，輕鬆就壓制住了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I am sorry but can you report this to Fresa on your way? You know who Fresa is?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
抱歉，你能順路把情況報告給弗雷薩嗎？你知道弗雷薩是誰吧？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
It is a situation so I am asking you a favor.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
情況緊急，只好拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Ee~~ ee~ ek~~~~~~~~~!!

[Nurse Lapplad]
Take those patients down quickly! You're an adventurer!!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
快把那些病人制伏！你可是冒險者啊！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I am sorry but can you report this to Fresa on your way? This is a favor.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
抱歉，能順路把情況報告給弗雷薩嗎？拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Strange? How did you get in here? You should be prohibited access..
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
真奇怪，你是怎麼進來的？這裡應該禁止入內...

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Hurts.. It hurts..
scripts.translation:
[病人]
好痛...好痛...

scripts.text:
[Patient]
I'm fine. They're making a fuss for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[病人]
我沒事。他們只是在小題大做。

scripts.text:
[Patient]
I keep feeling sleepy for some reason. Is it because I'm sick?
scripts.translation:
[病人]
不知道為什麼一直犯困。是因為生病了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Patient]
My head feels blank.. Uh? Did you say something?
scripts.translation:
[病人]
腦子一片空白...嗯？你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Ugh.. Feels like my whole body is cramped.
scripts.translation:
[病人]
呃...感覺全身都抽筋了。

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Urk.. I feel sick even though I didn't drink.
scripts.translation:
[病人]
嘔...明明沒喝酒，卻覺得噁心。

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Oh no is there a transfectant found in me..
scripts.translation:
[病人]
糟了，我不會是感染者吧...

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
We used to deliver things like daily necessities or research tools here before the accident.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
事故之前，我們曾在這裡運送生活必需品和研究工具。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Work that involved going out to other places a lot more even as a staff member here.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
以前我們這裡的職員也經常要外出辦事。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
What?! Is something going on? The Mechanicians and Facilities managers look busy.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
什麼？出什麼事了？機械師和設施管理員看起來都很忙。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Yaa~ Did you try the grapes?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
呀~你嘗過葡萄了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Isn't it great that we can grow fresh grapes in an underground evacuation facility like this?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
能在這樣的地下避難所裡種出新鮮葡萄，不是很棒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Some people are suddenly attacking others.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
有些人突然開始攻擊別人。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
What in the hell is going on?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
到底是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
They were talking about it in the broadcast since yesterday so you know the gist of the situation, right?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
從昨天起廣播就在說這件事，你應該知道大致情況吧？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
The contaminant is getting to the interior of the air-raid shelter so the decision has been made to move all supplies to the uncontaminated zone Z-2 that the Chemical Substance Specialists found.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
汙染物已經滲入避難所內部，因此決定把所有物資轉移到化學物質專家發現的未汙染區域Z-2。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
There was a request to move the cargo with the Adventurers since the scrawny researchers won't be of help.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
研究員們身材瘦弱，幫不上忙，所以有人提議讓冒險者來搬運貨物。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Alright- let's move the cargo to Zone Z-2 first.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
好，先把貨物搬到Z-2區。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
If you go to the machine Warehouse on your way back there will a person called Al. Tell him
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
回去時順道去機器倉庫找阿爾，告訴他：

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
^0000FFYou idiots!! Stop wasting material with stupid machines!!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
^0000FF你們這群白痴！！別再用那些愚蠢的機器浪費材料了！！^000000。

scripts.text: Eh?
scripts.translation: 誒？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Don't understand? Tell Al in the machine Warehouse
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
沒聽懂嗎？去機器倉庫告訴阿爾：

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
^0000FFYou idiots!! Stop wasting material with stupid machines!!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
^0000FF你們這群白痴！！別再用那些愚蠢的機器浪費材料了！！^000000。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Remember to get every postposition right and convey my feeling 100%.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
記得把每個助詞都用對，百分之百傳達我的語氣。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Transport the cargo to Zone Z-2 first.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
先把貨物運到Z-2區。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
On your way back go to the machine Warehouse and tell Al
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
回去時去機器倉庫找阿爾，告訴他：

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
^0000FF You idiots!! Stop wasting material with stupid machines!!^000000?? for me and come back.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
^0000FF你們這群白痴！！別再用那些愚蠢的機器浪費材料了！！^000000？替我傳達這句話，然後回來。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Did you deliver the goods to Zone Z-2?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
貨物送到Z-2區了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Oh! Wasn't there one more thing I requested? Did you send the message to the Mechanicians?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
哦！我是不是還托你辦了件事？你給機械師傳話了嗎？

scripts.text: Not yet..
scripts.translation: 還沒...

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Ah.. What should I do.. Should I go since most of the goods are moved?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
啊...我該怎麼辦...貨物大多搬完了，我是不是該親自去一趟？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
If I leave it like this those idiots who know nothing outside of machines might do something with the precious components...
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
要是放任不管，那群只懂機器的白痴說不定會糟蹋那些珍貴零件...

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
What should we do? Should I go? Or do you want to go back?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
怎麼辦？我去，還是你回去一趟？

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Do not go back.
scripts.translation: 不用回去

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Alright. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
好，那你回去一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Yeah? I guess the machine Warehouse is kind of far.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
是嗎？看來機器倉庫確實挺遠的。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Since we're almost done here I will finish up quickly and go. This is compensation for the work.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
這裡的工作差不多結束了，我趕緊收尾就過去。這是給你的報酬。

scripts.text: - The small round capsule has percolated through skin. It feels like experience has accumulated.
scripts.translation: - 小圓膠囊滲入皮膚，感覺經驗值增加了。

scripts.text:

Though our survival isn't sure because of the contaminant,
scripts.translation:

雖然汙染物讓我們的生存狀況難以預料，

scripts.text:

The chief researcher told us to adequately compensate the adventurers who were caught up in the explosion.
scripts.translation:

首席研究員還是指示我們，要妥善補償那些意外捲入爆炸的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Don't worry about it though.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
不過你不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
You conveyed my feeling right?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
你把我的語氣傳達到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
They should be smartened up by now. They wouldn't waste precious components again, right?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
他們現在應該長記性了吧？總不會再浪費珍貴零件了吧？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
It is a relief we were able to evacuate to the air-raid shelter interior in advance.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
幸好我們提前撤進了避難所內部。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
If we weren't able to evacuate..? We probably won't be here.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
要是沒能及時撤離...我們恐怕就沒命了。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Is there something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
A while ago the Facilities managers were running around in haste.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
剛才設施管理員們急匆匆地跑來跑去。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
What in the world?! You ate fresh grapes? Why didn't I get to eat them? Why?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
什麼？！你吃到新鮮葡萄了？為什麼我沒吃到？為什麼啊？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
This place is sure quiet. Why you ask?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
這裡真安靜。你問為什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Not many people come this far.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
很少有人會走到這麼遠的地方。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Ah! Come on in. It seems there are a lot of visitors today because of the broadcast this morning.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
啊！進來吧。看來今天早上的廣播引來了不少訪客。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
You're here because Ernon sent you right?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
你是埃農派來的吧？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
I have received the item you have brought.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
你帶來的東西我收到了。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Eh-? Are you taking it back? That is a lot of work.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
咦？你要把東西拿回去？那可夠麻煩的。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
You are going through a lot.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
真是辛苦你了。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務 -

scripts.text:
[Dimensional Device]
Do you want finish your travels and
go back to your original time?
^FF0000All traces in this place will be erased if you go back to your original time.^000000
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
要結束這趟旅程，回到原來的時間嗎？
^FF0000回到原來的時間後，這裡留下的一切痕跡都會消失。^000000

scripts.text: Stay here.
scripts.translation: 留在這裡。

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text:
[Dimensional Device]
Your whole body becomes heavy and time seems to be passing faster around you.
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
你感到渾身沉重，周圍的時間似乎流逝得更快了。

scripts.text: A mysteriously intense driving energy can be felt from this device.
scripts.translation: 這個裝置散發出一股神秘而強烈的驅動力。

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Pull it
scripts.translation: 拉動它

scripts.text: The surrounding distortion of time seems to be returning to normal.
scripts.translation: 周圍扭曲的時間似乎正在恢復正常。

scripts.text: This device's use cannot be figured out.
scripts.translation: 無法弄清楚這個裝置的用途。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
You're conducting a headcount?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
你在清點人數嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I am not sure. Maybe you can ask Al over there?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
我不太確定。也許你可以問問那邊的阿爾？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I mean the air cleaning unit you are moving now.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
我說的是你現在正在搬的那臺空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I made that. Isn't it awesome?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
那是我做的，厲害吧？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Ah!! You're the adventurer. You could check out the farm.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
啊！你是冒險者吧？可以去農場看看。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Isn't the farm good because it's warm? I made the temperature control device there. Isn't it awesome?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
農場很暖和，不錯吧？裡面的溫控裝置是我做的，厲害吧？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I am worried of the people suddenly attacking.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
我擔心大家會突然互相攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Since we're already here should I make something like a patient suppression device?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
既然都到這地步了，我是不是該做個能制伏病人的裝置？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I don't know why everybody is rejecting a device that can move heavy objects.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
我不明白大家為什麼都反對製造搬運重物的裝置。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I should have made one when they were making new air cleaning units..
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
早知道他們要造新的空氣淨化裝置時，我就該做一個了...

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Ugh.. I want to make something.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
唉...我真想做點什麼。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Who is that woman to conduct a headcount as if she's the leader?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
那個女人是誰？怎麼像個領袖似的清點人數？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
There wouldn't have been an explosion if there was no experiment the first place? Right?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
要是一開始沒有那場實驗，不就不會發生爆炸了嗎？對吧？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
I think the self-righteous and haggardly Fresa has changed.
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
那個自以為是、面容憔悴的弗雷薩好像變了。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
She's become more warm compared to the past, right?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
和以前相比，她待人更和善了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Fresa has definitely changed a lot.
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
弗蕾薩確實變了很多。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Today she is handing out grapes to people. In the past that would have been unimaginable.
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
今天她還在給大家發葡萄。放在以前，簡直不可想像。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Why is that Fresa acting like the leader alone but still hasn't taken measures?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
弗雷薩為什麼像個領袖似的獨斷專行，卻遲遲不採取措施？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Measures need to taken about the convulsing patients. Are you going to cover this up like in the past?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
必須處理那些抽搐的病人。你們還想像以前那樣把事情瞞下來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
So this is what's happening?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
原來是這麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
I should have known when she tried to half-ass things.
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
她之前敷衍了事的時候，我就該想到會出問題。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
I really don't like self-righteous and hypocritical Fresa.
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
我真討厭弗雷薩那副自以為是、虛偽的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Uh?! You're an adventurer too?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
咦？！你也是冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Ugh.. It seems you are unlucky as well.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
唉...看來你的運氣也不怎麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Don't you think this place is trying to exploit us Adventurers?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
你不覺得這裡在壓榨我們這些冒險者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
The Cafeteria food is good though.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
不過食堂的飯菜倒是不錯。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Grapes were served on the side today.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
今天還配了葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I like grapes. I want to eat more.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我喜歡葡萄，還想再多吃點。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
A friend I made here is confined in the temporary clinic. They found a transfectant or something.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我在這裡交的一個朋友被關進了臨時診所。他們說他感染了什麼東西之類的。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
To us adventurers a healthy body is an asset.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
對我們冒險者來說，健康的身體就是本錢。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I ate a lot of different things from adventuring places.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我在冒險途中嘗過各種各樣的東西。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I think the food here is one of the best.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我覺得這裡的飯菜算得上數一數二。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

我在冒險途中嘗過各種各樣的東西。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I think the food here is one of the best.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我覺得這裡的飯菜算得上數一數二。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Sorry. We aren't ready to distribute food yet.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
抱歉。我們還沒準備好分發食物。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Grab a plate or tray and wait in line.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
拿個盤子或托盤，然後排隊等候。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Oh no what should we do? We ran out of grapes.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
糟了，怎麼辦？葡萄已經吃完了。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
New grapes should be delivered from the farm soon. Do you want to wait?
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
農場很快就會送來新葡萄。你要等一會兒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Do you know that's the temporary clinic? You cannot go that way now.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
你知道那邊是臨時診所吧？現在不能從那裡通行。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
The passage is blocked because of convulsing patients.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
抽搐的病人堵住了通道。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
You are working hard.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
您辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Grab a plate or tray and wait in line.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
拿個盤子或托盤，然後排隊等候。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Ahh.. Why did I travel here..
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
唉...我為什麼要來這裡...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Hey don't think of going out that way. It's going to be dangerous because of the explosion.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
喂，別想從那邊出去。爆炸後外面很危險。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Today is strange. Hey do you see the mysterious device over there too?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
今天真奇怪。嘿，你也看到那邊那個神秘裝置了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
I think I said it 30 times today alone but there is no device at the door.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
我今天光這句話就說了30遍了，可門口根本沒有什麼裝置。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
I am itching for an adventure but safety outside isn't confirmed so don't think of going outside.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
我也很想出去冒險，但外面的安全狀況還沒確認，別想著出去了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
A while I ago I couldn't stop the Chemical Substance Specialists from going outside.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
剛才我沒能攔住那些化學物質專家出門。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Seeing how they didn't return, they must be dead, right?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
他們一直沒回來，肯定已經死了吧？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
The situation has grown out of control.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
局勢已經失控了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Haa- Should have I stopped those people leaving the air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
唉——我當初是不是該攔住那些離開避難所的人？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Today is strange. Hey do you see the mysterious device over there too?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
今天真奇怪。嘿，你也看到那邊那個神秘裝置了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
You cannot enter this area because it is under construction.
scripts.translation:
[門禁守衛]
該區域正在施工，禁止進入。

scripts.text:

According to the Facilities managers it will be later used as a Clinic.
scripts.translation:

據設施管理員說，這裡之後會改成診所。

scripts.translation:
[門禁守衛]
臨時診所目前只收治需要隔離的抽搐病人。

scripts.text:

I ask for your understanding.
scripts.translation:

感謝您的理解。

scripts.translation:

臨時診所目前只收治需要隔離的抽搐病人。

scripts.translation:

感謝您的理解。

scripts.text:

Movement in this area is currently prohibited.
scripts.translation:
[門禁守衛]
目前禁止在這一區域走動。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
I ask for your understanding.
scripts.translation:
[門禁守衛]
感謝您的理解。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
Aah- I don't know the reason but the control room is
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員 吉科]
唉——我也不知道為什麼，控制室

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
is damaged a lot. At this point it isn't a control room but a warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員 吉科]
已經嚴重損壞了。與其說是控制室，現在更像個倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
Ah the air cleaning unit doesn't belong here.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員 吉科]
啊，空氣淨化裝置不該放在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
If my memory is correct, you have to deliver them to Zones C-0, F-1, F-2, I-0, Z-0.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員 吉科]
如果我沒記錯，你得把裝置送到C-0、F-1、F-2、I-0和Z-0區。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
Haa- I have been cleaning the Control room for several days now
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員 吉科]
唉——我已經清理控制室好幾天了。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
This place cannot be organized no matter how I much organize it. I guess we should just use it for storage.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員 吉科]
這裡怎麼整理都收拾不乾淨。我看還是當倉庫用吧。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
Come on in. Welcome to the Warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員 吉科]
請進，歡迎來到倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
Urrghh
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員 吉科]
呃啊...

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
This is not the control room.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員 吉科]
這裡不是控制室。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
It's the warehouse!!
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員 吉科]
這裡是倉庫！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Patient~ That chair is quite high.. doesn't your head ache?
scripts.translation:
[護士]
病人~那把椅子挺高的...你不覺得頭疼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Why does he say he has a cramp? The other patients didn't have that problem.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
他為什麼說自己抽筋了？其他病人可沒這個問題。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Argh- I told you not to scribble on the floor while pretending to sleep.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
啊——我告訴過你，假裝睡覺的時候不要在地板上塗鴉。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
You ran around the elephant trunk thirty times so you must be sick. Claiming he can't feel dizziness. Quite the bluffer.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
你繞著象鼻跑了三十圈，肯定是生病了。還說自己一點都不暈，真能吹。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Ah geez! There is no other issues yet but why is he saying he's dizzy?
scripts.translation:
[護士]
哎呀！目前還沒發現其他問題，可他為什麼說自己頭暈？

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
So what do you mean!! Where does it hurt!!
scripts.translation:
[護士]
你到底在說什麼！！哪裡疼！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
What do you mean nothing is wrong, your face has gone purple.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
你說沒事，但你的臉都發紫了。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
It seems we can harvest grape tree number 1 without problems. What a relief.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師]
看來1號葡萄樹可以順利收穫了。真是鬆了口氣。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
My heart sank when the Mechanicians destroyed a tree..
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師]
機械師毀掉一棵樹時，我的心都沉了下去...

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
The soil grape tree number 2 is in seems to be lacking nutrition.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師]
2號葡萄樹所在的土壤好像缺少養分。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
We need to prepare fertilizer to provide the soil more nutrition.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師]
我們得準備些肥料，給土壤補充養分。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
I worried because a lot of weird stuff was growing around grape tree number 3.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師]
3號葡萄樹周圍長了很多奇怪的東西，害我擔心了好一陣。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
It seems the harvest will have no problem.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師]
看來收穫不會有問題。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
Grape tree number 4 has no particular problem.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師]
4號葡萄樹沒有特別的問題。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
Nutrition state good. Harvest state good.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師]
養分狀況良好，收成狀況也良好。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
The nutrition of grape tree number 5 is too good.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師]
5號葡萄樹的養分太充足了。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
That doesn't mean there will be a higher harvest yield..
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師]
不過，這不代表收成會更好...

scripts.text: There is a Memory Record somebody is recording.
scripts.translation: 有人正在錄製記憶記錄。

scripts.text: Listen.
scripts.translation: 聽。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Ah ah- One two three test- test-
scripts.translation: 啊啊——一、二、三，測試——測試——

scripts.text: To distinguish survival days in the air-raid shelter, today will be designated Explosion Day 1 after the experiment explosion.
scripts.translation: 為了記錄大家在避難所裡的生存天數，今天定為實驗爆炸後的第1天。

scripts.text: Everybody fell into panic after seeing the outside situation on the monitor after the explosion.
scripts.translation: 爆炸後，大家從監視器上看到外面的情況，全都陷入了恐慌。

scripts.text: But chief researcher Dr. Fresa calmly consoled everybody and checked how many survived.
scripts.translation: 但首席研究員弗雷薩博士冷靜地安撫了大家，並清點了倖存者人數。

scripts.text: The final number of survivors including adventurers seems to be 326.
scripts.translation: 包括冒險者在內，最終倖存者似乎共有326人。

scripts.text: The camera showing outside was damaged in the afternoon. It seems we cannot see the situation outside anymore.
scripts.translation: 下午，用來監視外面的攝像頭壞了。看來我們再也看不到外面的情況了。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 錄音到此為止。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 2
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第2天

scripts.text: A witch hunt against the director and chief researcher Fresa began.
scripts.translation: 針對總監兼首席研究員弗雷薩的批鬥開始了。

scripts.text: My opinion is different. The research and experiment was conducted under her direction but this is an accident.
scripts.translation: 我的看法不同。研究和實驗雖然都是在她的主持下進行的，但這只是一次事故。

scripts.text: If not Fresa, they would have made somebody else to blame.
scripts.translation: 就算不是弗雷薩，他們也會找別人來背鍋。

scripts.text: But she is handling it in a dignified manner despite concerns.
scripts.translation: 儘管眾人對她有諸多質疑，她仍從容應對。

scripts.text: She says problem solving is more important than blame and is checking assignments of survivors before the accident.
scripts.translation: 她說解決問題比追究責任更重要，正在重新確認事故發生前倖存者的工作安排。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 3
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第3天

scripts.text: Fresa.. She naturally became the leader of the survivors.
scripts.translation: 弗雷薩...她自然而然地成了倖存者們的領袖。

scripts.text: There was no vote of sorts, but nobody is complaining about her being the leader.
scripts.translation: 雖然沒有進行投票，但沒有人對她擔任首領提出異議。

scripts.text: The day before she had a briefing on the situation of the total survivors.
scripts.translation: 前一天，她聽取了全體倖存者的情況簡報。

scripts.text:
20 Bioengineers
16 Mechanicians
27 Facilities managers
10 Chemical Substance Specialists
Other than specialists the assignments of survivors such as cafeteria staff, janitors, gardeners, distribution directors, health professionals, adventurers caught in the accident have been assessed.
scripts.translation:
20名生物工程師
16名機械師
27名設施管理員
10名化學物質專家
此外，我們還統計了其他倖存者的分工，包括食堂員工、清潔工、園丁、配送主管、醫護人員，以及意外捲入事故的冒險者。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 4
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第4天

scripts.text: Everybody's work has been decided based on Fresa's briefing the day before.
scripts.translation: 所有人的工作都根據弗雷薩前一天的簡報安排妥當。

scripts.text: It was decided that researchers including myself know nothing much research and must continue our lives in the air-raid shelter under the guidance of those who have technical skill needed for survival.
scripts.translation: 包括我在內的研究員對許多事情都不甚瞭解，因此決定由掌握生存所需技能的人帶領我們，繼續在避難所裡生活。

scripts.text: First the Chemical Substance Specialists and Facilities managers started to install Air Contamination Gauge Sensors in the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation: 首先，化學物質專家和設施管理員開始在避難所內安裝空氣汙染監測感測器。

scripts.text: After evaluating that oxygen levels were low the Mechanicians have started to assemble Air cleaning units.
scripts.translation: 確認氧氣含量偏低後，機械師們開始組裝空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text: Lora, a former cafeteria employee was consulted on the important problem of food.
scripts.translation: 食物是個大問題，於是大家請教了前食堂員工洛拉。

scripts.text: We assessed that about 40 days of survival is possible based on the food in the warehouse and the number of survivors.
scripts.translation: 根據倉庫裡的食物儲備和倖存者人數，我們估算這些食物大約能支撐40天。

scripts.text: This prompted the Bioengineers to cultivate plants that can self-produce.
scripts.translation: 於是，生物工程師開始培育能夠自行繁殖的植物。

scripts.text: Other miscellaneous assignments were issued under Fresa's direction.
scripts.translation: 弗雷薩還安排了其他各種雜務。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 5
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第5天

scripts.text: I don't know the details but the air pollution level outside of the shelter was measured.
scripts.translation: 具體情況我不清楚，只知道有人測量了避難所外的空氣汙染程度。

scripts.text: According to the Chemical Substance Specialists the situation is hopeless.
scripts.translation: 化學物質專家說，外面的情況已經無可挽回。

scripts.text: It seems life in the air-raid shelter has to continue longer. Just can quietly keep working..
scripts.translation: 看來我們還得在避難所裡待很久。只能繼續默默工作...

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 21
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第21天

scripts.text: After silently working for several days the Bioengineers have good news.
scripts.translation: 生物工程師們默默工作了幾天後，終於帶來了好訊息。

scripts.text: They have succeeded in artificially germinating a plant that can self-produce.
scripts.translation: 他們成功人工培育出了一種能夠自行繁殖的植物。

scripts.text: Fortunately the air-raid shelter has a warehouse spacious enough to grow plants in.
scripts.translation: 幸好避難所裡有個足夠寬敞的倉庫，可以用來種植。

scripts.text: It seems we can forget about our food problem now.
scripts.translation: 看來食物問題總算解決了。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 30
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第30天

scripts.text: A small problem has occurred in the air-raid shelter. The air cleaning units made in the beginning are broken.
scripts.translation: 避難所裡出了點小問題：最初製造的空氣淨化裝置壞了。

scripts.text: Fortunately there will be no problem maintaining oxygen concentration levels thanks to the air cleaning units the Mechanicians made without approval.
scripts.translation: 幸好機械師們未經批准就製造了新的空氣淨化裝置，因此氧氣濃度仍能維持在安全水平。

scripts.text: They are too heavy so adventurers were deployed because nobody else is able to move them.
scripts.translation: 新裝置太重，其他人都搬不動，只能派冒險者去搬。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 錄音到此為止。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 32
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第32天

scripts.text: Today is the first harvest of the grape tree cultivated by the Bioengineers.
scripts.translation: 今天是生物工程師培育的葡萄樹首次收穫的日子。

scripts.text: Although there was a small problem of the Mechanicians destroying one grape tree
scripts.translation: 雖然機械師弄壞了一棵葡萄樹，出了點小插曲，

scripts.text: The air-raid shelter residents are throwing a small party to celebrate the successful harvest.
scripts.translation: 避難所的居民還是辦了個小型派對，慶祝成功收穫葡萄。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 錄音到此為止。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 38
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第38天

scripts.text: Chemical Substance Specialists and some Adventurers sick of living in the air-raid shelter have left the shelter to measure the air.
scripts.translation: 一些受夠了避難所生活的化學物質專家和冒險者離開避難所，去測量外面的空氣。

scripts.text: They have not returned by evening.
scripts.translation: 直到傍晚，他們都沒有回來。

scripts.text: Was the freedom of outside better than the life in the dark air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation: 難道外面的自由，比在黑暗避難所裡的生活更好嗎？

scripts.text: After midnight the remaining Chemical Substance Specialists assessed that they were dead and everybody had a brief moment of silence.
scripts.translation: 午夜過後，剩下的化學物質專家認定他們已經遇難，大家為他們默哀了片刻。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 40
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第40天

scripts.text: A dark rumor is going around the shelter.
scripts.translation: 避難所裡開始流傳一個不祥的傳聞。

scripts.text: There is a rumor that a contaminant from the outside has invaded the air-raid shelter because of the people who left a while ago.
scripts.translation: 有人說，之前離開的人把外面的汙染物帶進了避難所。

scripts.text: Is it because of the contaminant? There are patients who suddenly convulse and attack others.
scripts.translation: 是汙染物造成的嗎？有些病人會突然抽搐，還會攻擊別人。

scripts.text: Under the leader Fresa's decision, everybody was checked and those found with transfectants were quarantined in the temporary clinic.
scripts.translation: 在首領弗雷薩的決定下，所有人都接受了檢查；體內發現感染體的人被隔離在臨時診所。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 錄音到此為止。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 43
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第43天

scripts.text: The rumor in the air-raid shelter has come true.
scripts.translation: 避難所裡的傳聞成真了。

scripts.text: The remaining Chemical Substance Specialists have confirmed that the contaminant is eroding into the air-raid shelter
scripts.translation: 剩下的化學物質專家確認，汙染物正在侵入避難所內部。

scripts.text: And Fresa and experts have started taking measures.
scripts.translation: 弗雷薩和專家們已經開始採取措施。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 45
scripts.translation: 實驗爆炸後的第45天

scripts.text: The invading contaminant will not stop.
scripts.translation: 入侵的汙染物沒有停止擴散。

scripts.text: It has been decided to move all equipment and necessities to the less contaminated Zone Z-2
scripts.translation: 大家決定把所有裝置和必需品都轉移到汙染較輕的Z-2區。

scripts.text: And facility managers have started to install a partition in Zone Z-0 to prevent the contaminant from coming in further.
scripts.translation: 設施管理員們開始在Z-0區安裝隔離牆，阻止汙染物繼續侵入。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 錄音到此為止。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: The mechanical device thrown on the floor cannot be determined if it is still operable.
scripts.translation: 扔在地上的機械裝置，不知道還能不能用。

scripts.text: There is a Memory Record somebody is recording.
scripts.translation: 有人正在錄製記憶音盤。

scripts.text: Listen.
scripts.translation: 聽。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Oh- Is this a memory record? Does it work? Oh it works. Works! Should I try it since I'm bored?
scripts.translation: 哦，這是記憶音盤嗎？還能用嗎？好像能用。真能用！反正閒著也是閒著，要不聽聽？

scripts.text: My name is Maso an Adventurer traveling the world. Today is 4th day of entering the air-raid shelter? 3rd day? The vibe here is weird and hard to adjust to.
scripts.translation: 我叫馬索，是個周遊世界的冒險者。今天是進避難所的第4天？還是第3天？這裡氣氛怪怪的，真讓人不習慣。

scripts.text: Verus city has Adventurers amongst its original population but the treatment towards Adventurers is strangely good.
scripts.translation: 維魯斯城的原住民中也有冒險者，不過他們對冒險者好得有些反常。

scripts.text: The mood is that Adventurers are people caught up in an uncontrollable accident and need to be treated well.
scripts.translation: 大家似乎覺得，冒險者只是意外捲入這場無法控制的事故，應該好好對待。

scripts.text: As an Adventurer who eats and plays as much as he works, I cannot stand the itching for action. Urgh
scripts.translation: 我這種平時吃吃喝喝、到處冒險的傢伙，真受不了這股無處發洩的勁。唉。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Is today day 6? Details aren't told to Adventurers so I am not sure but the people of Verus city seem very gloomy.
scripts.translation: 今天是第6天嗎？冒險者得不到太多訊息，我也不確定。不過維魯斯城的人看起來都很沮喪。

scripts.text: The Adventurer's blood is boiling and wanting to explore places but there isn't much to do.
scripts.translation: 我這個冒險者渾身熱血沸騰，恨不得出去探索，可這裡根本沒什麼事可做。

scripts.text: I looked around the air-raid shelter but whoever designed it has not one artistic hair on him.
scripts.translation: 我在避難所裡四處看了看，設計這裡的人恐怕一點藝術細胞都沒有。

scripts.text: It is no fun to keep looking at the same hallways and same room lay outs.
scripts.translation: 每天看著同樣的走廊和房間佈局，實在無聊。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Is today day 21? The Verus City people look happy to have solved the food problem.
scripts.translation: 今天是第21天嗎？食物問題解決了，維魯斯城的人看起來很高興。

scripts.text: It is cute to see the mild looking researchers going around cheering and screaming.
scripts.translation: 看著那些平時溫文爾雅的研究員到處歡呼尖叫，還挺可愛的。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: The 30th night but because it's always dark I don't really know if it's night or day. I just ate supper so it must be night.
scripts.translation: 今天是第30個夜晚。不過這裡總是黑漆漆的，我也分不清白天黑夜。剛吃過晚飯，應該是晚上吧。

scripts.text: Today I moved the really heavy air cleaning units made by the Mechanicians with the other Adventurers.
scripts.translation: 今天我和其他冒險者一起，搬動了機械師們製造的那些非常沉重的空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text: The air-raid shelter is so large that I had no idea where they were but thanks to that I became friends with some of the Adventurers, especially Castle and Blat.
scripts.translation: 避難所太大了，我根本不知道他們把裝置搬去了哪裡。不過這次倒讓我結識了幾位冒險者，尤其是卡斯爾和布拉特。

scripts.text: By the way the Mechanicians seem to have mental problems. They make a ruckus for not being able to make machines and got dragged out by the guards.
scripts.translation: 順便一提，機械師們好像有點不對勁。他們因為沒法制造機器而大吵大鬧，最後被衛兵拖走了。

scripts.text: The Mechanicians are definitely going to cause trouble someday.
scripts.translation: 機械師們遲早會惹出麻煩。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Today is day 32 and I worked on the grape harvest.
scripts.translation: 今天是第32天，我去幫忙採收葡萄了。

scripts.text: I ate fresh grapes and since I don't have anything to do anything to do, I'm going to sleep early.
scripts.translation: 我吃了新鮮葡萄，反正也沒什麼事可做，就早點睡吧。

scripts.text: Ah.. the grape was good, I want it again. Did they say harvest was possible once every 2 weeks?
scripts.translation: 啊...葡萄真好吃，還想再吃。聽說每兩週就能收穫一次？

scripts.text: Today is the 38th day of being in the shelter and there is a fuss since the morning.
scripts.translation: 今天是待在避難所裡的第38天，一大早就鬧鬨鬨的。

scripts.text: This morning the recruited Adventurers to join the Chemical Substance Specialists for an investigation outside the air-raid shelter, many volunteered despite the dangers.
scripts.translation: 今天早上，他們招募冒險者和化學物質專家一起去避難所外調查。儘管有危險，還是有很多人自願參加。

scripts.text: I am of the belief danger should be avoided but my friends Castle and Blat volunteered.
scripts.translation: 我覺得還是避開危險比較好，可我的朋友卡斯爾和布拉特都自願去了。

scripts.text: Well I understand that they were sick of living in the shelter for a while.
scripts.translation: 不過我也明白，他們在避難所裡待膩了。

scripts.text: They have not returned past the afternoon. Verus City leader Fresa has concluded that the people who left are dead.
scripts.translation: 他們直到下午都沒回來。維魯斯城的領袖弗雷薩認定，離開的人已經遇難。

scripts.text: Everybody had a moment of silence at dawn. They were good people so it is sad to part like this.
scripts.translation: 天亮時，大家為他們默哀了一會兒。他們都是好人，想到就此分別，真讓人難過。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Is it since the morning of the 40th day? There is a mysterious infectious disease going around the shelter.
scripts.translation: 是從第40天早上開始的嗎？避難所裡好像出現了一種神秘的傳染病。

scripts.text: A few people have suddenly attacked those near them and convulsed
scripts.translation: 有些人突然開始抽搐，還攻擊身邊的人。

scripts.text: And Adventurers have been deployed to suppress the convulsing people because a lot of the weak researchers are wounded.
scripts.translation: 許多體弱的研究員受了傷，於是派冒險者去制伏那些抽搐的人。

scripts.text: There is a rumor saying a contaminant came in because of the people who went outside the shelter a while go.
scripts.translation: 有人傳言，之前離開避難所的人把汙染物帶了進來。

scripts.text: Lunch during day 44 the air-raid shelter leader Fresa gathered the Adventurers and had a presentation.
scripts.translation: 第44天午餐時，避難所領袖弗雷薩召集冒險者，向大家說明了情況。

scripts.text: The rumor has been confirmed true and a safety partition will be built in Zone Z-0
scripts.translation: 傳聞已經得到證實，他們決定在Z-0區建一道隔離牆。

scripts.text: A decision has been made to move necessities to Zone Z-2 tomorrow and I heard they need the help of Adventurers.
scripts.translation: 他們決定明天把必需品轉移到Z-2區，聽說需要冒險者幫忙。

scripts.text: I have to work tomorrow so I am doing to sleep early.
scripts.translation: 我明天還得工作，今晚早點睡。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
I don't know what brings you here but please don't touch anything.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
我不知道你來這裡做什麼，不過請別碰任何東西。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
I haven't finished checking the stock and it would be annoying if anything went missing.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
我還沒盤點完庫存，要是少了什麼東西就麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
You're an adventurer. You don't have to deliver air cleaners here.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
你是冒險者吧？不用把空氣淨化裝置送到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
It's a warehouse anyway. The independent air circulation system is enough.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
反正這裡是倉庫，有獨立的空氣迴圈系統就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
Aahh- Looking after the warehouse is annoying.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
唉...看倉庫真煩人。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
There is nobody to rotate my shift
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
沒人能替我輪班。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
Wha- wha- wait stop!!
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
什...什...等等，住手！！

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
You're not here to ambush me right? It's alright if not.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
你不是來偷襲我的吧？不是就好。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
Are you here to move items?
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
你是來搬運物品的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
The goods in this warehouse should not be today I think? From what I know today we are moving necessities first.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
今天不該搬這個倉庫裡的貨物吧？我記得今天應該先轉移生活必需品。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hello adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你好，冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I don't know the reason, but Fresa assigned me here.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我也不知道原因，不過弗雷薩把我派到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I always wondered why I was assigned here but now I think I know the reason.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我一直納悶為什麼把我派來這裡，現在大概明白了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
It is to watch if the Mechanicians make useless things.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
原來是要監視機械師們有沒有又在搗鼓沒用的東西。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The Mechanicians occasionally want to make something.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
機械師們偶爾會想造點什麼。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
My job is to stop them.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我的工作就是攔著他們。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I hear patients these days are convulsing and attacking the people around them?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我聽說最近有些病人會抽搐，還會攻擊身邊的人？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The Mechanician constantly convulse saying they want to make something so it's not weird to me.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
機械師們老嚷嚷著要做東西，抽搐起來我倒也不覺得奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The convulsion of Mechanicians are reaching extremes.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
機械師們抽搐得越來越厲害了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
They are convulsing so much I may need to call back up.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
他們抽搐得這麼厲害，我可能得叫增援了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hello adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你好，冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
We are seeing if there are hazardous substances within the air-raid shelter according to emergency protocol.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
我們正按照緊急協議，排查避難所內是否存在危險物質。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
You want to know how many Chemical Substance Specialists there are? Go to Karsten then. Should be here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
想知道化學物質專家有多少人？去找卡斯滕問問吧，他應該就在附近。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
This next room is temporarily being used by the Chemical Substance Specialist.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
下一間房暫時由化學物質專家使用。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
We tightly hid away dangerous things but don't touch anything just in case.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
危險物品都被我們嚴嚴實實地藏好了，不過以防萬一，還是別碰任何東西。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
Karsten gave me grapes.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
卡斯滕給了我一些葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
How fresh and tasty it was.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
又新鮮又好吃。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
My colleagues left the air-raid shelter to investigate and haven't come back.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
我的同事們離開避難所去調查，到現在還沒回來。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
It was concluded they are dead but are they really all dead? I want to see my colleagues.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
大家都認定他們已經遇難了，可他們真的全都死了嗎？我想再見見我的同事。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
Good work.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
We are working to find a solution for the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
我們正在設法解決汙染問題。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I found this while looking around the air-raid shelter
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我在避難所裡四處檢視時發現了這個...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
but there is a lot of this on the wall. What can it be?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
可牆上到處都是這種東西。到底是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I have been investigating this for 30 days already but I do not know what it is.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我已經調查了30天，還是不知道這是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I am too proud to ask somebody.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我又拉不下臉去問別人。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I have been investigating this for 32 days already but I do not know what it is.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我已經調查32天了，還是不知道這是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
Ugh what to do.. Should I just ask somebody?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
唉，該怎麼辦...要不還是問問別人？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I have been investigating this for 40 days already.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我已經調查40天了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
My pride won't let me quit now.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我的自尊心不允許我現在放棄。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
45 days have passed since I started investigating this unknown thing.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
調查這個未知的東西，已經過去45天了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
How did I come to investigate this?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我當初為什麼會開始調查這個來著？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Dally]
Darn it!! Frustrating
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 達莉]
可惡！！真讓人惱火！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Dally]
Sister- Run~
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 達莉]
姐姐，快跑~

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Dally]
Brother- Run~
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 達莉]
哥哥，快跑~
